claim: The native XAX server drives a host-granted native XAX compiler over MCP STDIO: it describes the current store, resolves and builds it, and applies one XAXEDIT1 transaction with the compiler's native edit command.
label: PROTOTYPE
scope: one seed program, one constant mutation, one host and one local compiler prototype; not a general construct/build/execute loop

compiler.status: local XAX-built prototype outside the pinned XAX tree; not committed to XAX f79b532 and not shipped by this repository
compiler.construct: not available; no native carrier decoder exists

seed.description: a form-2 windows-x86_64 build request for a tiny program whose first constant is 40

steps.evidence: the server read the seed store from the host-granted path and reported its canonical root
the server spawned the compiler twice: resolve wrote snapshot.xax, build wrote artifact.exe and artifact.prov; the server read both files back
the carrier names the seed's first constant node (function f70ba768..., block 0, node 0) and sets it from 40 to 41
the server decoded the hex carrier, wrote it to the work directory, ran the compiler's edit command, and replaced current.xax with the edit output
a later query reports the edited store

measurements.method: one server process; 10 xax_query calls, 5 xax_build calls, then 5 xax_transaction calls on successive constants 41..45; each is a full JSON-RPC round trip over STDOUT/STDIN pipes; medians of the raw samples
measurements.interpretation: build and transaction dominate because each spawns the native compiler as a child process; the server's own handling is sub-millisecond. These are not XAX code-generation benchmarks.

test.name: tests/test_native_stdio.py::test_native_compiler_chain_over_stdio
test.result: passed on 2026-10-19 (the same server store and seed as this file)

limits: The compiler is a local prototype outside the pinned XAX tree; a reproducible committed native compiler is still upstream work.

Only query(root), resolve+build of the current store, and one XAXEDIT1 edit are exercised; workspace handles, typed mutations, expected-generation checks, pagination and construct are not implemented.
xax_execute is refused; no OS sandbox exists, so no artifact was executed.
One program and one constant mutation; this is not evidence of a general construct/build/execute loop.
